scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a rural road and collides with a bicyclist who abruptly cuts left across the road from the right shoulder.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along the rural road, then emergency brakes and swerves left to avoid a collision.

adversarials.behavior: The bicyclist rides along the right shoulder and then abruptly cuts left across the road without yielding to traffic.

requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves an sudden emergency braking and swerving event; the scenario terminates after the collision occurs between the ego vehicle and the bicyclist.
